summary_rationale: Lenskart Solutions has built a genuine vertically integrated omnichannel eyewear moat, scaling consolidated revenue from ₹900 Cr in FY20 to ₹8,814 Cr in FY26 (and ₹10,383 Cr TTM) while expanding operating margins from -8% in FY22 to 19.9% in FY26 (21% TTM) and generating ₹846 Cr of free cash flow in FY26. Its automated Bhiwadi manufacturing hub, ~69.6% gross margin, 9M+ Gold loyalty members, and 20%+ India same-store sales growth support a COMPOUNDER_PASS business quality verdict. However, kpi_health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because Ind AS 116 lease capitalization widens the gap between statutory EBITDA (₹1,754 Cr) and pre-Ind AS EBITDA (~₹1,000–1,032 Cr), ROE (6.55%) and ROCE (8.08%) remain in single digits amid heavy capex (Hyderabad plant) and Owndays goodwill, promoter ownership is low at 17.52%, and potential interest capitalization warrants ongoing monitoring.
